name: Southern Oregon Chiropractic- Doctors Park

considerations: Vehicle access is provided from Doctors Park Dr into a paved parking lot in front of the building. The site is a single-story medical office building within a multi-building campus that includes neighboring clinics and shared parking. Sidewalks connect the lot to the main entry. Circulation is available through the front lot and adjacent drive lanes. Landscaping is present around the building but does not block overall site access.
